channel.title: The Crypto Playback
channel.description: Daily research and news on Bitcoin and digital assets, with 16 live market indicators.

item.title: Bitcoin Dips, Banks Dive In
item.description: Bitcoin slid under $83,000 and ETF investors bolted for the exits, even as banks, phone makers, and governments quietly doubled down on crypto infrastructure.

item.title: Regulators Retreat, Wall Street Wades In
item.description: Washington is quietly dismantling crypto surveillance rules just as traditional finance giants start plugging into the chain, even while bitcoin itself can't seem to clear $87,000.

item.title: Golden Crosses, Golden Handcuffs
item.description: Bitcoin keeps flashing bullish signals while regulators, treasuries, and hackers all scramble to keep up with the same rally.

item.title: Uptober Opens Green While an Old Foe Gets a New Job
item.description: Bitcoin is holding its ground against a surging dollar and a parade of corporate treasury theatrics, while Washington quietly rearranges the deck chairs on crypto oversight.

item.title: Shorts Get Squeezed, Congress Gets Skipped
item.description: Bitcoin ripped back above $85K on the back of a brutal short squeeze this week, while Washington's crypto bill died (again) and everyone from Visa to the ECB quietly kept building anyway.
